scene: A couple stroll hand in hand along a wooden seaside pier at a peach summer sunset; one looks back smiling, bright ocean reflections and a small distant lighthouse.

label: A farmers market cooking challenge
scene: Two apron-clad rivals present separate tomato-and-basil salad bowls at a summer market while an older vendor tastes a sample as judge; separated hands and expressive competitive faces.

label: Fireworks create the perfect moment
scene: Two adults stand close together on a summer lakeshore watching gold and coral fireworks reflected in the water, one gently taking the other's hand; expressive illuminated profiles.

label: A summer job becomes something more
scene: Two summer cafe colleagues pause while setting tables; the man offers a palm-sized posy of three daisies instead of cutlery while the woman smiles shyly with a towel and utensils in hand.

label: The last day of vacation approaches
scene: A wistful traveler closes a small suitcase in a sunny seaside guest room while a companion waits by the open balcony door; blue ocean, tender hesitant eye contact.

label: A kiss at the water's edge
scene: Two adults share a gentle kiss at the edge of a calm summer lake, feet on a wooden landing, natural hands resting on each other's arms; golden reflected light and fresh green reeds.
